source_text: Audivit Iothor omnia quae fecit Deus; gavisus est. Proselytus confitetur: Nunc cognovi quia magnus Dominus.
pass_a_gloss: Heard Jethro all-things which did God; rejoiced he-is. Proselyte confesses: Now I-have-known that great Lord.
pass_b_english: [[Jethro heard all God had done and rejoiced >> Bible:Exodus 18:1-9]]. The proselyte confesses: [[Now I know that the Lord is greater than all gods >> Bible:Exodus 18:11]].
